_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. IBANs are stored without the country prefix and without spaces. Relative paths resolve against the project root.
_comment_accounts: Map each IBAN to the account name you created in the app. The names must match exactly or imported transactions land on the wrong account.
_comment_savings: Money arriving from these accounts is income from your own savings, not new income. Leave empty if you have none.
_comment_filters: Banks word the same event differently, so the phrases that classify a row live here rather than in the code. All matching is lowercase substring matching against the transaction title plus counterpart name.

filters._comment_transfer_to_account: A rule fires when EVERY phrase in match appears. Use it for rows that are really a transfer into another account you track — a cash withdrawal is a transfer into your cash account.
filters._comment_skip_incoming: Card top-ups book both legs without an IBAN, days apart. Keep only the outgoing leg or the money is counted twice.

_comment_split: One transfer that actually pays several things. Exactly one part takes "remainder" and absorbs whatever the fixed parts leave. total_range is the sanity check that keeps unrelated payments to the same account intact. Leave empty unless you have such a payment.
_comment_hints: Extra instructions appended to the categorization prompt. Use them for local knowledge the category names alone don't convey.
prompt_hints: EV charging stations belong under car fuel, not utilities
_comment_eb: Enable Banking credentials. Register your own application at enablebanking.com, download the private key, and put the app id here. See docs/ENABLE_BANKING.md.

enable_banking._comment_aspsp: Which bank each IBAN belongs to, as Enable Banking names them. default_aspsp covers every IBAN not listed here.
